gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all custom fields in the Jira instance to understand what data points are available for my projects.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of all custom fields, including their IDs, names, and types.

gold.user: As a product owner, I need to create a new custom field for tracking user feedback in our Jira projects.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the creation of the custom field with its ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch custom fields in a paginated manner to efficiently handle large datasets.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a paginated list of custom fields, including metadata for pagination.

gold.user: As an admin, I need to review trashed fields to decide which ones to restore or permanently delete.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of trashed fields, including their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to update the configuration of an existing custom field to better fit our project needs.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the update of the custom field with the new configuration details.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I want to retrieve the contexts associated with a specific custom field to understand its usage.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a list of contexts for the specified custom field.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I need to delete a custom field that is no longer in use to keep our field list clean.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the deletion of the custom field.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to restore a previously deleted custom field that is still needed for reporting.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the restoration of the custom field with its details.

gold.user: As a product manager, I need to trash a custom field that is no longer relevant to our current projects.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming that the custom field has been moved to the trash.
